A defined scope

Know what we
are building together.

Requirements, deliverables, and acceptance criteria are agreed for your project. The items below are topics to define during discovery, rather than a fixed package.

  • Business questions, metric definitions, and source inventory
  • Data pipelines and transformation rules within the agreed scope
  • Dashboard or report layouts reviewed with users
  • Data-quality checks and access requirements
  • Documentation and an agreed approach to maintenance

Common questions

Before we begin.

Can you work with spreadsheet-based reporting?

Yes. A project can start by reviewing existing spreadsheets and exports. The next step may be better reporting processes, a connected dashboard, or a data pipeline.

Do we need a new data platform?

Not necessarily. We first assess the current tools, data volumes, and reporting needs. A new platform is an option to evaluate, not an assumed requirement.

What makes a dashboard useful?

Clear definitions, relevant measures, dependable source data, and a connection to a real decision are more valuable than a large number of charts.
